title: Preserve boot recovery and higher-priority holds before emitting the local withheld-Resume refusal
outcome: Local withheld-Resume diagnosis does not pre-empt readiness recovery or misattribute project-reset, runtime-stop or control-disabled holds.
acceptance: Reconstruct a reachable retained head with the matching admission-binding cause and a boot-recovery readiness hold; a deterministic regression verifies the ordinary lazy-recovery request is not bypassed by a local refusal.

Project-reset, runtime-stop and control-disabled states preserve their existing governing disposition rather than saving misleading cancellation advice; exact stamp/ACK and unknown-application no-replay guarantees remain intact.
Independent review has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the maintained gate passes on the exact landing input.
